english_news.title: The October jobs report is out Friday. Here's everything to expect

english_news.title: Democratic sweep gives markets a reason to rethink path of interest rates
english_news.summary: Rate hikes could be curbed by an Iran war resolution, slower U.S. growth and fresh fiscal policy — but none are set in stone.

english_news.title: Moderna raises 2026 outlook as CEO says newer vaccines are gaining traction
english_news.summary: The biotech company now expects 2026 revenue growth of 15% to 25%, up from its previous guidance of up to 10%.

english_news.title: Small retailers brace for 'huge hit' this holiday season as shipping costs spike
english_news.summary: As shipping costs surge due to high fuel prices, smaller and medium-sized retailers struggle to keep up, and they face a difficult holiday season.

english_news.title: Montana votes to ban corporate political money. Next stop? Probably the Supreme Court
english_news.summary: Montana voters approved a novel strategy to restrict corporate political spending, setting up a constitutional fight that could reach the Supreme Court.

english_news.title: AI debt concerns grow as ING reportedly seeks buyers for $500 million of data center loans
english_news.summary: ING is reportedly seeking bids for about $500 million across 12 data center loans, including debt tied to a New Mexico Stargate site.

english_news.title: Neocloud IREN says $4 billion in annualized revenue being delayed due to customer request
english_news.summary: Following a dramatic plunge in its stock price, IREN said some revenue is being delayed from 2026 until early next year.

english_news.title: Outside groups urge congressional Dems to target corporate interests over Trump
english_news.summary: Groups and strategists advising Democrats are warning them to use their investigative tools on corporate interests, rather than on President Donald Trump.

english_news.title: White House denies Hegseth and Rubio to leave jobs after Republican election losses
english_news.summary: US media reports there are calls to replace Pete Hegseth, who also faces a possible impeachment vote, while Marco Rubio is rumoured to be eyeing a presidential run.

english_news.title: Trump signs order to preserve Oval Office as national monument
english_news.summary: The order comes after Trump made a series of big changes to the decor of the Oval Office and tore down the White House East Wing.

english_news.title: Two dead after bus crashes in France, officials say
english_news.summary: One child and one young adult were killed in the crash, local authorities say, with more injured.

english_news.title: Kenyan doomsday cult leader given life sentence for murdering 191 people
english_news.summary: Paul Mackenzie ordered his followers to starve their children to death in a forest so they could "meet Jesus".

english_news.title: Pope begins lengthy trip to Latin America weeks after lung cancer surgery
english_news.summary: Pope Leo, who had part of a lung removed last month, will visit Uruguay, Argentina and Peru.

english_news.title: Tanzanian opposition leader found guilty of inciting unrest but acquitted of treason
english_news.summary: The 58-year-old, who has been detained since April last year, says the charges are politically motivated.

english_news.title: Elon Musk appears to signal the end of the road for Cybertruck
english_news.summary: Musk said it was to make room for production of its Cybercabs - autonomous taxis without a driver.

english_news.title: Somalia's top court rejects president's term extension amid political crisis
english_news.summary: The country's first nationwide elections since 1969 are due next year - a timetable now thrown into doubt.
